_note: SafeMaster parallel-port parity vectors (brief Rule 3: any scoring logic change must be mirrored in both ports). Canonical copy: backend/src/routes/__fixtures__/safemaster-vectors.json. MUST be kept byte-identical to frontend_v2/src/lib/__fixtures__/safemaster-vectors.json. Golden expected values were generated by running the backend scoreRoutePath directly against each vector (see docs/IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md Phase 2) -- do not hand-edit expected values without re-deriving them the same way. The dense-route-sampling vector specifically guards against a real divergence found and fixed during Phase 2: the frontend sampleLine used to be index/count-based (capped at 40 samples) while the backend was distance-based (~every 250m); for a dense real-world OSRM route the two produced different sample sets and could silently disagree on incidentsOnRoute. Both ports are now distance-based.
